transport.title: Getting there
transport.text: City buses run to the intercity bus station and the centre of Antalya; timetables are in the Antalyakart app or by phone 0242 606 07 07. The AntRay tram runs airport — city centre — intercity bus station — Fatih district. Tour operator desks with their buses meet tour company passengers at the terminal exit.

taxi.title: Taxi
taxi.text: Taxi ranks are opposite the exits of all terminals; drivers wear airport badges. Fares are on the information board next to the rank; online booking is available through the airport taxi cooperative (antalyaairporttaxi.net).

storage.title: Left luggage
storage.text: Left luggage is in the arrivals hall of the domestic terminal; it can be used by passengers departing from terminal 1 or the domestic terminal. Baggage wrapping is available round the clock, for a fee, in the departure halls of terminals 1 and 2.

parking.title: Parking
parking.text: Multi-storey car park for 2,643 cars opposite the domestic terminal. The price is calculated on the airport website; season passes are issued at the service centre on Level 1 (P1).

wifi.title: Wi‑Fi
wifi.text: Free internet for 1 hour in all terminals. PIN codes are issued by free Wi‑Fi kiosks in the arrival and departure halls; a mobile phone and a passport or ID card are required. In the CIP terminal and rest areas access is unlimited.
